object.description: In a repository of PARENT and CHILD, call validate_repo: (a) with no validation error; (b) after defining on CHILD a required attribute that its one object doesn't set; (c) with CHILD's object file left with merge conflict markers instead. Expected: (a) an entry per document, PARENT and CHILD, each with its document ID and no errors; (b) CHILD's entry holds an ATTR_MISSING_REQUIRED error with a code and a message, and PARENT's entry holds none; (c) an entry for PARENT alone.
